theorem prop_7_1_5 {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) :
    ∃ E₂ : ℝ, |E₂| ≤ 2e-6 + 366.91 / √x ∧
      ∑' n : ℕ, Λ n * Real.log n * etaPlus (n / x) ^ 2 =
        0.640206 * x * Real.log x - 0.021095 * x + E₂ * x * Real.log x :=

note: Lean states the E₂ form with the book's constants only for x ≥ 4.9·10²⁶, and the E₁ form only with error 10⁻⁸ x log x. Erratum: The derivation of (9.94) (expform.tex:2300-2331, book p.197) writes the cross term as 2*int(eta_+-eta_o)eta_o log(xt) but adds its Cauchy-Schwarz bound 1.944e-6 log x + 5.2e-7 only once; with the factor 2 the same argument gives 3.890e-6 log x + 1.261e-6, hence only |E_2| <= 3.936e-6 + 366.91/sqrt(x) at x = 1e12 (and the log x coefficient alone exceeds 2e-6 for every x). (checked by `scripts/checks/proposition_7_1_5.py`).
